transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I'm here because I need help dealing with the people who are constantly monitoring and tracking me. They are trying to sabotage my life and harm me, and I need to find a way to make them stop.
Have you been experiencing any significant mood swings, depression, or periods of elevated mood or irritability along with these feelings of being monitored?
No, I don't really have mood swings or depression, and my mood is generally normal. I just feel very stressed and anxious all the time because of the constant monitoring.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that others cannot see or hear, in addition to feeling like you're being monitored?
No, I have never experienced anything like hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there. But I still know, without a doubt, that those people are actively monitoring and tracking me.
How long have you been experiencing these feelings of being monitored, and have they been persistent or have they come and gone over time?
I've been dealing with this constant monitoring for about a year and eight months now. It has been completely persistent during this entire time, without ever really stopping or coming and going.
Are the people you believe are monitoring you known to you, such as friends, family, or acquaintances, or are they unknown individuals or organizations?

I'm not entirely sure of their exact identities or who they are working for. I just know for a fact that they are constantly watching and monitoring me wherever I go. It's hard to pinpoint exactly who is behind it, but the tracking is definitely happening.
Has your belief that you're being monitored significantly impacted your daily life, relationships, or ability to work or socialize?

Even though the monitoring causes me a lot of stress and makes me very cautious, it hasn't completely ruined my life. I still manage to go to work, handle my daily chores, and interact with others relatively normally. Apart from taking precautions to protect myself from them, I am still able to function.
Can you describe some of the specific precautions you've been taking to protect yourself from the people you believe are monitoring you?
I haven't really taken any major or specific precautions to protect myself. Mostly, I just try to stay highly alert to my surroundings and keep to myself as much as possible.
Do you believe that the people monitoring you are trying to harm you physically, or is their goal more related to ruining your reputation, controlling your thoughts, or something else?

Yes, I believe they are absolutely trying to harm me physically as well as ruin my life. Their intentions are entirely malicious, and they are constantly looking for ways to hurt me or disrupt everything I do. It is a very real, dangerous threat that keeps me constantly anxious.
Is your delusion primarily focused on the belief of being persecuted, in that you feel you are going to be harmed, harassed, and so on, by an individual, organization, or other group?

I wouldn't call it a delusion because it is very real, but yes, I feel completely targeted and harassed by them. I am constantly worried that this group or organization is going to physically harm me or find ways to ruin my life.
Do you think your belief of being monitored and targeted is the only issue affecting your life, or are there other concerns or problems that you feel are also significant?

Yes, being monitored and targeted is absolutely the only major issue disrupting my life. Aside from the stress of dealing with them and having to stay constantly alert, my work, daily routine, and overall health are completely fine. I don't have any other mental or physical concerns.
